methodDeviations: Base URL http://localhost:3400/almond -> http://localhost:3410/almond; outputs to eval2/b.

Measurement starts >= 6 s after load (baseline ~4.5 s); the sheet opens 6 s after load (baseline 3 s). Motion sampling windows are unchanged (150-1650 ms and 3000-4500 ms after load / after the sheet click).

analyze.mjs adds: reward-colour pixel accounting in the first-viewport pixel pass, a DOM inventory of reward-coloured elements, and alt counts. Every baseline metric re-computes identically from the baseline records (checked).

New scripts: selstate.mjs (selected vs unselected, run offline on both record sets), rewardscan.mjs (whole-content reward pixels, light and dark for all five screens), compare.mjs, finalize-after.mjs. finalize.mjs was copied but not run: its summary strings are hand-written facts about the old build.
limitations: impeccable detect / detect.js not shipped (advisory mode) - not downloaded or run.
Live menu https://almond-gules.vercel.app/api/menu/app blocked (localhost only), as in the baseline; the bundled menu rendered.
Web build only (react-native-web); native rendering, hitSlop, native shadows not measurable.
Before-side whole-content reward scan impossible (old build not served); the before DOM has 0 chromatic colours on every screen, so it is 0 by construction.
Selected-state groups use the default selection (verified live with aria-selected/aria-checked/aria-current on the after build); dark Order/sheet not in the baseline scope.
